thread_text:
carol: kicking off config-only canary now. adjusting routing policy to prefer-cost with latency fallback, lowering batch.window_ms from 20 -> 15, and nudging global rate cap 800 -> 700. rolling 10% -> 25% over 30m. no model changes, just runtime params.

deploy-bot: canary start accepted (canary_id=cfg-c-3098765432). targets: 10% of traffic, window 30m. monitors: latency/err/throughput/synthetic.

alice: watching the 99p latency dash. will alert if +15% over baseline.

bob: FYI pinned enterprise routes to previous routing-profile for safety: `route:enterprise-payments -> routing-v1-2025-04`. had a quick chat with sales.

dinesh: running synthetic traffic against canary at 50 qps to look for queueing effects. expect small changes in token-level latency only.
sre-bot: metric-check: us-west-2 95p latency +7% at t+90s, error-rate unchanged.
eva: saw a small increase in router 5xx on a subset of backends, ~0.4% -> 0.9%. looks correlated with batch.window change maybe. digging in.
alice: can we set a rollback threshold? propose: error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR 95p latency +20% -> auto pause and rollback.
carol: agree. set gating rule now. gating config applied.
sre-bot: gating rule active: error_rate_threshold=0.5%, sustained_window=180s, latency_mult=1.2.
eva: we're seeing spike concentrated on older GPU hosts (hostpool-gpu-legacy). adding a temporary routing pin for enterprise routes to avoid them.
bob: thanks, pinned via `routing.pin(customer=enterprise-payments, variant=stable)` :thumbsup:.
dinesh: telemetry shows synthetic latency normalized after pin. cost delta roughly -6% at 10% traffic.
sre-bot: alert: error-rate breached threshold (0.85%) at t+6m. initiating protective action: pausing canary rollout.
carol: pausing rollout. deploy-bot please abort incremental roll to 25% and start rollback to previous config.
deploy-bot: abort acknowledged. rolling back config set cfg-c-3098765432 -> cfg-stable-3098000000. executing.

deploy-bot: rollback completed. canary terminated. traffic reverted to stable routing/profile. incident tag: cfg-rollback-3098765432. Took ~1m30s.

alice: nice quick turn. leaving short watch window for 10m. anyone seen lingering errors?
eva: error-rate back to baseline after rollback. will open a follow-up channel to collect logs and root-cause.
bob: can we add a note to the release notes: "Config-only attempt adjusted routing and batching; paused/rolled back due to transient routing error spike on legacy hosts. No model or customer data change."
carol: yes add to release notes and mark as "paused - retry in low-traffic window". Schedule next attempt at 00:30 PT.
dinesh: I'll prepare a narrower canary: target only non-critical routes and synthetic ramp to 100 qps for 15m before broadening. Also will exclude hostpool-gpu-legacy.
sre-bot: created ticket INF-4729 for postmortem + hostpool remediation, and INF-4730 for next-canary checklist.
eva: adding logs and traces to INF-4729. linking dashboards.
bob: pinging customer success to inform any impacted clients. small note to release notes done.
carol: thanks team. closing this thread after watch. next steps documented in INF-4729 and release notes. :wave:
